purpose: Document independent city-specific first-party registry discovery and bounded anonymous cadastral/urban-parcel service investigation.
assessment: Fresh English and Gujarati discovery found first-party Gujarat Revenue Department land-record/property-card services and the Department of Land Resources NAKSHA portal. The current NAKSHA JavaScript/configuration was inspected for parcel routes; anonymous requests to the public host returned 404 and no safe parcel geometry/native ID response was found. No GeoJSON sample is retained.
registryAssessment: registryFound is true because official Gujarat land-record/property-card infrastructure and a national urban parcel-mapping portal were actually evidenced. This does not establish an open Nadiad-specific feature layer, local municipal parcel API, or citywide coverage.
